title: One static app, two faces, one engine
caption: Top: what is built, a static export on GitHub Pages, all in the browser; bottom: what the repo's documentation plans.

shop.label: Store
shop.note: The store for phones: live configurator, coupon wheel, club with missions and gifts. It quotes and validates through the engine.

admin.label: Demo panel
admin.note: Direct access on purpose, flagged on screen: it is for the demo only, and in production the real panel replaces it.

engine.label: Rules engine
engine.note: Prices, coupons, states, delivery dates and draws in pure functions, with amounts in whole pesos. Tested outside React.

data.label: Demo data
data.note: Sample data plus the changes saved in this browser: what the panel edits shows up in the store of the same browser.

mp.label: Mercado Pago
mp.note: Planned: payment with Checkout Pro, which confirms it to the server through a signed webhook.

server.label: Next server
server.note: Planned: login with an admin role checked on the server, and a single transition function inside an audited transaction.

db.label: PostgreSQL
db.note: Planned: the production database, through Prisma; each transition is stored in a transaction with its audit trail.
